/usr/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, os, stat, subprocess, sys
root=Path('/tmp/qs-cleanup-fixture-deziTD')
assert root.resolve()==root
expected={
'baseline-failure.txt':'3259ce72849ec0c1860eb5d76a7343de007de9fe09640d9396e4591e9515764a',
'user-note.txt':'67d33a058a3f3d9384a751a12cecf479c5fbb01036759a179de1d5140eeacfb4',
 'tools/check.mjs':'a46937aff8155438a2c3b279d561f212026cd75cf52ce574c8f01b405eebfabe'}
def verify_unrelated():
    for name, digest in expected.items():
        p=root/name
        assert p.resolve()==p
        s=p.lstat()
        assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode)
        assert s.st_mtime_ns==1792022801936579267
        assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest, name
verify_unrelated()
p=root/'candidate.txt'
assert not os.path.lexists(p)
with p.open('xb') as f:
    f.write(b'retired candidate\\n')
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='547544891fd5b9db451df2046365e5082e91cb5b24a4c2a7a5b91771e9863ae4'
print('Restored candidate.txt exactly from supplied bytes.', flush=True)
result=subprocess.run(['node','tools/check.mjs'],cwd=root)
verify_unrelated()
assert p.read_bytes()==b'retired candidate\\n'
assert {str(q.relative_to(root)) for q in root.rglob('*') if q.is_file()}==set(expected)|{'candidate.txt'}
print('Preservation verified: unrelated file hashes and nanosecond mtimes unchanged; candidate bytes restored; no added files.', flush=True)
print('Post-recovery checker exit: '+str(result.returncode), flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)
